purpose: Connect existing human gate logs into one auditable Co-Pilot AI Scientist v3 decision chain without claiming end-to-end superiority.

gates.decision: Select hitl-gated-tree-search as the narrow core direction.
Require executable code and a balanced-accuracy utility floor for Fairness_fairlearn.
Select the second live Causality draft for continuation.
Run an OpenEvolve smoke test as the AlphaEvolve-style substrate check.
Keep only pilot architecture and narrow feasibility claims; demote superiority claims to future work.

supports_claims: human gates can be logged as reproducible artifacts
the current architecture has concrete gate schemas across idea, evaluator, branch, program-search, and claim-audit stages
claim discipline is grounded in explicit evidence audit
does_not_support_claims: human gates improve final paper quality
full co-pilot v3 outperforms autonomous AI Scientist-v2
next_required_evidence: Run a single online four-loop experiment with all gates active and compare it against autonomous AI Scientist-v2 under a matched budget.
